description: Public-procurement record of a Portuguese company from IMPIC's Portal BASE (weekly open-data files on dados.gov.pt, under the source's own terms; every public contract since 2012): contracts WON by NIPC (buyer, subject, procedure and contract type in closed lists, CPV, lots, contract/base/final prices in EUR, dates, duration, framework agreement, closure, bidder count, contract modifications), contracts ISSUED as a buyer, notices in the Diário da República; newest first, capped at 100. Winners and bidders published without a NIF are never named, only counted; a party whose NIF starts with 7 or 9 (estate, fund, condominium, partnership without legal personality, non-resident) is neither named nor identified, counted in `ecartes`. 400 without charge for a natural-person NIF or an invalid check digit; 404 without charge for a 7 or 9 NIF (forme_juridique_non_servie) or when nothing is found (absence is not conclusive). Price $0.02. When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

nipc.description: Portuguese NIPC (tax identifier of a legal person): nine digits with a valid check digit, PT prefix and separators tolerated, e.g. 504904493

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_portuguese_company_public_procurement

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
